alex (new-hire): hey all, first week here. quick q about secrets for my service `searcher`: how do i request Vault path + KMS access? do new hires get temporary creds by default or full perms?
nora (DevEx): welcome! :wave: flow is lightweight: create a secrets-request (web form or `onboarding-bot create-secret-request`). default is read-only in dev. request write or deploy perms explicitly. link: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/secrets-request
onboarding-bot: Request received: SR-2026-415. Next steps: 1) DevEx verifies ticket, 2) Infra provisions KMS role or key-use policy, 3) Security reviews for prod access, 4) sign secrets handling checklist. Track: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/SR-2026-415
chris (eng-sec): quick policy note: we do NOT hand out KMS admin or raw decrypt for prod keys. Services get a kms:encrypt/decrypt role via service identity; humans get vault token with scoped policies or ephemeral tokens. If you need elevated ops, include justification and owner signoff in the ticket.
alex (new-hire): got it. any naming conventions / paths i should use in the request?
ben (infra): use `kv/data/services/<team>/<service>` for KV v2. KMS key ids are `projects/redwood/kms/keys/<team>-<service>-key`. Add the exact envs (dev/stage/prod) and consumer identities. Example: `kv/data/services/search-team/searcher` and kms `infra-searcher-key`.
alex (new-hire): how about ephemeral creds? want something for feature branches w/o long-lived secrets.
nora (DevEx): use our ephemeral flows: for tokens `vault token create -policy="feature-search-<id>" -ttl=2h`. For DB creds use the DB plugin: `devex db-ephemeral issue --service searcher --ttl 4h`. CI can request these via role-account JSON. Avoid committing creds.
alex (new-hire): if i need to rotate a password (feature branch or prod), what's the flow?
ben (infra): branch-level: use `devex secret rotate --service searcher --scope=branch-<id>` which creates a new secret version and updates CI vars. Prod: open a change ticket and coordinate a maintenance window if needed.
chris (eng-sec): incident rotations: file an incident and mark secrets compromised. Security + oncall will trigger revokes, rotate KMS keys if cross-account exposure, and ensure downstream tokens are reissued. Our containment SLA for critical leaks: 4 hours. Full remediation depends on downstream systems but targeted within 24h.
alex (new-hire): do i need to sign anything before i get access?
nora (DevEx): yes: complete the secrets handling checklist and training quiz. `onboarding-bot` will block final prod perms until checked off.
onboarding-bot: Checklist pending for SR-2026-415: [ ] secrets-handling signed, [ ] team membership confirmed, [ ] audit training passed.
ben (infra): i've granted `team/searcher-dev` read on `kv/data/services/search-team/searcher` and created an ephemeral policy for feature tokens. Try `vault login` then `vault kv get kv/data/services/search-team/searcher`.
alex (new-hire): i can `kv get` in dev, but get denied for `prod` (expected). thanks everyone, this cleared up my flow. :pray:
nora (DevEx): great! saved checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/secrets-onboarding and rotation playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rotation. Ping me if prod access needed and include risk/owner in ticket.
chris (eng-sec): one more: all rotations are logged — we keep immutable audit trails in Vault and KMS logs for compliance.
alex (new-hire): perfect. Appreciated the quick help!
